names: Potassium tartrates (i) Monopotassium tartrate (cream of tartar) (ii) Dipotassium tartrate

more_info.uses: EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, table-top sweeteners in tablets. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.overview: Potassium tartrates is classified in food technology as an acidity regulator. Its technological role is to control acidity.
